contentBlocks.body: Strings carry helper methods that return new strings. trim() removes surrounding whitespace and toUpperCase() returns an all-caps copy. Strings are immutable, so these methods never change the original.

contentBlocks.code:
const raw = "  forge ";
const clean = raw.trim().toUpperCase(); // "FORGE"

contentBlocks.body: **Worked example.** trim returns a string without outer whitespace. toLowerCase runs on that returned string. Strings are immutable, so the original input remains available for display or diagnostics.
trim does not remove spaces inside a string. Normalization rules must match the task.
